## Stage 1 — the FP outcome seal (REQ-XH-121)

- `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_seal.rs` — `hh-fp-sealed-view/1` (cost fields
  only; every outcome member → `withheld{sealed_until_results}`) +
  `hh-fp-dev-projection/1` (verdict/reward/verifier fields *removed*).
  `ViewKind` = gate_readout | checkpoint_readout | committed_summary |
  operator_console | site_internal; `SealClass` = agent_slot (sealed) |
  reproof | smoke | probe | pp0_ag_evidence (the declared unsealed

  refuses a PP0 record carrying a task verdict; `dev_projection`
  strips recursively. The seal opens only at FP-RESULTS (R6.48).
- `crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_30.rs` — 6/6 green (AC-1: sealed views on
  all five consumers; outcome field fails the schema check in gate
  readout / checkpoint / dev projection; unsealed classes pass, PP0
  verdict refuses. AC-2: dev projection has no verdict/reward/verifier
  member; infra member readable by an R6.29 hold fixture while a
  verdict read refuses).
- `scripts/site/fixtures/phase2-fp-sealed.json` — the sealed-state
  presentation fixture (`fixture:true`, `hh-comparative-results/1`):
  every outcome member is `withheld{sealed_until_results}`, outcome-

  absent — a sealed readout cannot show them. `scripts/site/tests/

  Deliberately not a named `inputs.json` entry — a second fp packet
